Component Specific API Reference Guide

OpenClovis API Reference Guide is provided for the following components:

High Availability

  • Availability Management Service
  • Component Manager
  • Checkpointing Service
  • Group Membership Service

System Management

  • Alarm Manager
  • Chassis Management
  • Fault Manager
  • Clovis Object Repository (COR)
  • Provisioning Library
  • Performance Management Library

Communication Infrastructure

  • Message Service
  • Event Service
  • Intelligent Object Communication
  • Name Service
  • Remote Method Dispatch

Basic Infrastructure

  • Basic Services:
    • Execution Object (EO) Service
    • Log Service
    • Operating System Abstraction Layer (OSAL)
    • Timer
    • Debug Service
    • Handle Management
  • Containers/Memory Management:
    • Container Service
    • Circular List Management
    • Queue Library
    • Bitmap Management
    • Buffer Management
    • Heap Management
  • Data Management:
    • Database Abstraction Layer (DBAL)
    • External Data Representation (XDR)
  • Common defines, structures, and functions
  • OpenClovis Test API
  • Rule Based Engine (RBE)
